about: Vitruvian Manager's sources, version 1 (PRP-SCHOLAR-USP-DESIGN.md 5.1, stage S1; completed to every source of the licence inventory of 18 November 2026 under MP-11, 20 November 2026): each with its citation, a short name for legends, its licence, its address, and its terms as read. termsUrl, termsQuote and termsRead record where the terms were read, the words that decide, and when; termsNotRead says why they could not be read, in place of a quote. standing is VM's reading of those terms: 'free' (they permit commercial use, redistribution and adaptation), 'not-free' or 'unclear'. terms is what VM does with the source: 'host' (VM may host its values, with the credit it asks), 'cite-only' (VM may cite and link to it, hosting none of its rows), 'not-held' (VM holds and shows none of it: retired, or read live by the visitor on the visitor's own terms), 'pending' (held, with a plain line on the page, until VM's owner decides; decision says what waits) or 'later' (on VM's owner's list for later). where says where VM uses it or used it; held:false means VM keeps none of it; inventory names its row in the inventory. A careful record of the terms as read, not legal advice. The cite-only entries agree with integration/scripts/cite-only.mjs (a test checks it both ways).

sources.inputs: EN.POP.DNST rests on FAO's land area (its Source field names FAO). FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/, read 20 November 2026): "Unless specified otherwise in their metadata or webpage, all datasets disseminated through FAO corporate statistical databases ... are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0)"; they may be adapted and re-disseminated, but "shall not be used for or in conjunction with the promotion of a commercial enterprise" nor to suggest FAO's endorsement. VM uses them for neither. The FAOSTAT land-use domain's own metadata could not be read (its interface answered "Missing Authorization Header"). Every series VM holds that rests on FAO's land area is treated alike, on FAO's own terms.

sources.originators: An originator's own terms decide over the World Bank's label (MP-11). The International Energy Agency's terms (https://www.iea.org/terms, read 20 November 2026) list "Standalone datasets, data explorers and databases" as content not made available under CC BY 4.0, and its terms for that material (https://www.iea.org/terms/terms-of-use-for-non-cc-material) bar "making more than 5 (five) raw data points from the Non-CC Material, whether or not aggregated, accessible for download". So EG.USE.PCAP.KG.OE, EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS and EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5, which name the IEA among their sources though their metadata reads CC BY-4.0, are not hosted (omni/scripts/build-wb.mjs, BARRED). The Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation's terms (https://www.healthdata.org/about/terms-and-conditions and its data record for the GBD 2023 air pollution exposure estimates, read 20 November 2026) let its data be "used, shared, modified or built upon by non-commercial users" only, so EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3 is not hosted. The International Telecommunication Union's terms of use (https://www.itu.int/en/about/Pages/terms-of-use.aspx, read 20 November 2026) give its content "for personal, educational, or non-commercial purposes" and bar commercial use without its written permission; its DataHub refused VM's reader (HTTP 403, "Request blocked"); so IT.CEL.SETS.P2 and IT.NET.USER.ZS are not hosted. The UN Population Division's page (https://population.un.org/wpp/, tried 20 November 2026) holds no terms in its text, so the series resting on it (SP.POP.TOTL, SP.POP.GROW, SP.DYN.LE00.IN, SP.DYN.TFRT.IN, SP.DYN.IMRT.IN, SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS) stay with "originator's terms not read" said in their methods, as do those resting on the IMF, OECD, UNESCO, WHO, UNICEF, ILO, WIPO, UNODC, the UN Statistics Division, Eurostat, national statistical offices and central banks, and the Luxembourg Income Study. omni/scripts/build-wb.mjs lists each originator (ORIGINATORS: address, date read, words seen) and stops when a series names a barred originator without a BARRED line, or names none it knows.
